children: Tata Consultancy Services Limited (NSE:TCS) is seeing renewed investor interest as eased PERM worries, robust AI momentum—including AI revenue >$3B, data‑centre and Industrial Intelligence Foundry launches—and steady dividends (FY26 Rs111, Q2 FY27 Rs12) underpin upgrades and bullish technicals.
Previous Week Recap
TCS Dividend Announcement FY26
: TCS declared FY26 dividends totaling Rs110 per share across tranches; reported FY26 dividend sum Rs111 (yield ~4.7%). For Q2 FY27 it announced a Rs12 interim dividend, record date Oct 14, 2026.
TCS Withheld Q3 Variable Pay
: TCS withheld Q3 variable pay for C3A+ staff after missing internal targets; juniors get full pay. Q3 revenue $7.64B (+2.4% YoY), annualized AI revenue >$3B, workforce 598,056, shares up 6.2%.
TCS Technical Outlook: Support, Resistance
: TCS shows support around Rs 1,970–2,000, resistance near Rs 2,500. Rising volumes and bullish RSI divergences Mar–Sep 2026. Suggested long entry Rs 2,075–2,135, target Rs 2,325, stop Rs 2,000.
TCS Data Centre Expansion
: TCS has entered the data centre business, adding AI‑infrastructure and data‑centre services to its IT offerings, expanding its digital infrastructure capabilities for enterprise clients.
TCS Rebound On Regulatory Ease
: TCS shares rebounded as US PERM regulatory worries eased given the firm's limited exposure, fueling renewed investor interest and supporting the stock's recovery in recent trading.
TCS Axis Buy, Targets Boosted
: TCS: Axis kept Buy, Rs2,360 target citing strong order book and AI momentum. PL Capital boosted FY27/28 revenue forecasts, cut EBIT margin view amid MHP integration, Buy, Rs2,390 target.
TCS CEO On AI Margins
: TCS CEO K Krithivasan said AI investments will have limited short-term impact on margins, enabling continued aggressive growth and sustained AI spending while margins stay near forecasted levels.
Geojit Buys TCS With Target
: Geojit maintained a BUY rating on Tata Consultancy Services Limited (TCS) and set a revised target price of Rs 2,530, valuing the stock at 16x FY28E adjusted EPS.
TCS Industrial Intelligence Foundry
: TCS launched Industrial Intelligence Foundry to boost AI-led autonomy for manufacturing. Company says it can cut new product introduction time ~25% and raise manufacturing productivity 20–25%.
Mystate Chooses TCS Bancs
: Mystate chose TCS Bancs, Tata Consultancy Services' core banking platform, to modernize and replace its legacy core systems across Mystate’s banking operations.
